references.text: The parallel prohibition against sexual relations with one's sister is found here, stating that one must not uncover the nakedness of one's sister, whether she is the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother.
Elaborates on the prohibition against sexual relations with a half-sister from the father's side.
Continues the theme of punishment for sexual relations with close relatives, including the mother's sister and the father's sister.
Contains a curse upon anyone who lies with his sister, whether she is the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.
Ezekiel condemns those in Jerusalem who have violated their sister, their father's daughter.
The story of Amnon and Tamar illustrates the consequences of breaking this prohibition, even though Tamar suggested that the king might grant permission.
